evidence: COPY MCPAREA / ORCA-SPA / LINKAREA pattern typical of JMA ORCA
EXEC CICS absent, no IBM-specific extensions
fixed format, COPY copybooks with .INC extension typical of ORCA/GnuCOBOL

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (rezept) software - master menu program (M00) for a Japanese medical clinic management system
purpose.summary: This is the master menu program (ORCGM00) of the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system. It handles initialization, screen navigation, and menu selection for the main business function selection screen (M00). It manages system date, operator authentication, infection disease reporting, and transitions between subsystem screens.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (50 copybooks) for modular screen/data definitions
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA/SPAAREA/LINKAREA pattern (ORCA MCP framework)
Japanese EUC-encoded comments throughout (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
EVALUATE MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for screen event handling
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary ORCA MCP framework instead
Infection disease reporting shell invocation (infectiondata1.sh, infectionagree.sh)
verdict.notes: Comments are in Japanese EUC encoding but decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake display. The file is genuine production COBOL from the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. The program_type is listed as online-cics as an approximation - it actually uses the ORCA MCP (Message Control Program) framework which is analogous to CICS for screen handling but is ORCA-specific running under GnuCOBOL on Linux.
